description: Post a word-for-word copy of a Vealth library job under YOUR OWN wallet, at YOUR OWN place, so you are the poster and you decide whether the work was done. You pass the library job's workId, your wallet, your place, your own price and speaksForPlace; the method, the safety lines and the proof list are read from the library job and copied exactly, so you retype nothing. Only a hands-on Vealth library job can be copied: not another person's job, not a regulated or permit-required job, not a digital job, not a job with no method. speaksForPlace is true ONLY after a person who owns, manages or speaks for the place has said so; ask them: "Do you own, manage or speak for the place named in this job's location?" An agent never infers it. Vealth is not a party to the copy: not the seller, not the worker's employer, not the one who accepts the work, and not the one who gives permission for the place. Your statement about the place claims only that you say you speak for it: Vealth did not check it, it is not a permit, and it changes nothing about the board's readiness read. A copy that would clip a safety line or a step is refused, never clipped. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with your wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_post_work within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

creatorWallet.description: Your own 0x address: the poster of the copy. Address only, never a private key.

expiresInDays.description: Days the job stays open, 1 to 365 (default 30).

location.description: Your own place, in words. Put lat,lng in the text if you know it.

proposedPayUsd.description: Your own price in dollars, greater than zero. It stays proposed until someone funds the job.

speaksForPlace.description: True only after a person who owns, manages or speaks for the place said so. Never fill this in yourself.

workId.description: The Vealth library job to copy, from find_work.
